_doc: The fact record of the main user query (src/rag/fact_record.py, flag FACT_RECORD). deadline_s: the whole step, beside round 1. chunk_chars: the text is read in pieces of about this size, cut at paragraph and sentence ends, in parallel (workers). A reply's max_tokens: tokens_base + tokens_per_char x the piece's characters, at most tokens_max. gap_words: a stretch of a sentence the model left out comes back by the rule when it has at least this many words (a whole sentence left out always comes back). prompt_system is read by the model only: no string here reaches the reader.
